title: Edge-Centric Adaptive Neural Activation via Parametric Tanh Functions
abstract: arXiv:2610.34154v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Within the broader landscape of artificial intelligence architectures, this paper introduces a compact, edge-centric neural framework that resolves the computational bottlenecks of modern edge-activated paradigms like Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) while retaining their expressiveness over traditional Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs). While KANs demonstrate remarkable representational capacity by placing learnable univariate functions on connection edges rather than hidden nodes, their reliance on non-local B-splines introduces severe optimization hurdles, high memory overhead, and poor hardware scaling. translated_title: 基于参数化Tanh函数的边缘中心自适应神经激活
translated_abstract: 在更广泛的人工智能架构领域，本文提出了一种紧凑的、以边缘为中心的神经框架，该框架解决了现代边缘激活范式（如Kolmogorov-Arnold网络，KANs）的计算瓶颈，同时保留了其相对于传统多层感知机（MLPs）的表达能力。虽然KANs通过将可学习的单变量函数放置在连接边上而非隐藏节点上，展现了卓越的表示能力，但它们对非局部B样条的依赖带来了严重的优化障碍、高昂的内存开销以及较差的硬件扩展性。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了参数化Tanh连接函数，这是一种平滑、有界的架构基元，定义为 $a_{\tanh}(x;\delta,\alpha,\beta,\gamma) = \delta + \alpha \tanh(\beta x + \gamma)$。该公式将偏移量、振幅、局部斜率和水平位移统一整合到一个轻量级的、包含4个参数的可微分函数中。
tldr: 本文提出参数化Tanh连接函数，用仅含4个可学习参数的平滑有界函数替代KANs中的非局部B样条，在保留边缘激活网络表达能力的同时，有效解决了其优化困难、内存开销高和硬件扩展性差的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Parametric Tanh Connection Function, a lightweight 4-parameter smooth and bounded activation that replaces non-local B-splines in edge-centric networks like KANs, resolving their optimization hurdles, memory overhead, and hardware scaling issues while preserving expressive power.
